Hi Oliver/Emma — thanks for the detailed asks. Short answers before the deep-dive: 
- KMS: yes, Hosted supports customer-managed KMS for key-wrapping via our enterprise plan; well document the flow and provide a key rotation checklist.
- Dedicated pinning: Dedicated pools can be constrained to region and AZ affinity; we recommend Multi-AZ for high availability but can provide an AZ-reserved pool for lower variance during evaluation.
- Cold-starts: for a 13B family on us-east-1 g5-like hardware, median cold-token latency is ~28-40ms and P95 around 110-160ms depending on batch sizing. Well bring detailed bench numbers.

Agenda for 4pm PT technical deep-dive (30m):
- 5m: intros + success criteria
- 10m: deployment modes tradeoffs (hosted/dedicated/private) + examples for PHI workloads
- 10m: region/AZ guarantees and KMS integration patterns
- 5m: actions and ownership on MAP

Deliverables by Thu EOD: pricing spreadsheet (Dylan), SLA draft (Karthik), and a short runbook for deployment and key management (Marissa).

-Karthik
